title: Consignment HX-26-0310: notebook cartons found substituted on delivery
question: When consignment HX-26-0310 was opened in Vienna, four cartons held ceramic tiles instead of notebooks. Where in the chain of custody between Leipzig and Vienna did the substitution most likely happen, what supports that, and what can't the evidence settle?
summary: A two-pallet notebook consignment travelled from a Leipzig distribution centre through a Plzen cross-dock hub to a Vienna consignee, and on delivery part of it was found substituted.
